id: title:Gilbert09:stop reporting transient debugbear errors as exceptions

review.posthog_relevance: Adds transient error classification and regression tests to the warehouse ingestion workflow, potentially reducing unnecessary failure notifications or retries for transient edge blips.
review.reason: Adds a new method get_retryable_errors returning transient error strings and adds unit tests asserting transient error classification. This could help distinguish transient, recoverable HTTP status codes from permanent failures in warehouse ingestion, potentially reducing unnecessary failure notifications or retries. Tests provide regression protection against misclassification.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on the frequency and impact of transient errors in the warehouse ingestion workflow, which is not established by the code alone. The classification and tests are present, but the operational benefit is not demonstrated.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new method get_retryable_errors returning a set of transient error strings, while get_non_retryable_errors remains unchanged.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the Temporal activity worker to distinguish transient, recoverable HTTP status codes from permanent failures, potentially reducing unnecessary failure notifications or retries for transient edge blips.

observations.behavior: Adds unit tests asserting that transient error messages are classified as retryable and that client authentication errors are not classified as retryable.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection for the classification of transient HTTP status codes against the DebugBear warehouse source.
